_comment: Explicit CI shard assignment for the browser suite (4 parallel runners). Every e2e/*.spec.ts must appear in exactly one group (scripts/e2e-shard.mjs enforces this in CI). E10 generated route coverage replaces the old duplicate axe route loops; focused legacy keyboard/menu/theme regressions remain. Generated scans are split across browser-b/c/d from measured runtimes; no fifth runner. 2026-10-06: the generated route scans and the read-only owner/portal section scans run in Playwright parallel mode (both workers), and desk-workspace (to c) and staff-security (to a) moved off browser-d; measured test-seconds before the move were a 117, b 119, c 104, d 176.
